Apps & Websites for Your Trip to Vietnam

Published on 7/30/2026

Preparation

  • E-visa: evisa.gov.vn (this is the official one, don't fall for any of the scam websites)
  • E-visa agents: lynnvisa.vn or find agents in Vietnam Visa Advice group on Fb (they can expedite applications or handle special cases)
  • Fast track pass for Saigon airport immigration clearance: klook.com (search for "Tan Son Nhat Fast Track Service" to find providers)

Transportation

  • Ride-hailing apps: Grab, Xanh SM, Be
  • Long-distance bus: Vexere
  • Local bus: Busmap.vn

Money

  • QR payments: Moreta Pay (this app allows you to link your credit card and then pay by QR code, which is widely accepted)
  • Banks: Vietcombank, Sacombank, Timo Bank (note, it's possible to open a bank account on a tourist visa, but you won't get a ATM card)

Communication

  • Apps: Zalo (wide-spread), Fb (also wide-spread), Instagram (younger crowd), Threads (trending)
  • Carriers: Viettel (a bit more expensive, better coverage) and Mobifone (a bit cheaper, less coverage, SIM expires fast if not regularly topped up)
  • Dating: Tinder, Badoo, Bumble, Fb Dating, Tantan (90% freelancers & ladyboys) - don't limit yourself to just one, use them all

Translation

  • Apps: Google Translate (no censorship), ChatGPT (some censorship), Gemini (little censorship), Grok (very little censorship)

Mongering

  • Gaito websites: anchoi.xxx, banhbeo.net, Checkerviet, Rphang (these are local escort sites, more details here)
  • Discount app for massage parlors: Camapro (you have to pay a small fee to register and get the discount codes)
  • Massage parlor reviews: kiki25massagesaigon.review
  • Telegram group for mongering discussion: https://t.me/+dkgFN0KoznRiZWRl
